conservative.requirements: 7 power, a flat surface within close range that is within shadow effect: A shadowy pit opens on the flat surface you designate and remains there while this spell is recharging. It is dark and difficult to see, and once a character falls in, the shades inflict a number of wounds equal to the caster's Int turn until he manages to climb out. Checks to avoid or escape the pit are generally of Average (2{Dc}) difficulty, but this may vary.
conservative.name: Pit of Shades
